ObjectStates.LuaScript:
--[[
    Portable Platform by Nyss AKA Liyarin
    https://steamcommunity.com/id/Liyarin/myworkshopfiles/?appid=286160
]]

saved_data = {
  height = 4,
  width = 4,
  raise = 4,
  options = false,
  heldBy = nil,
  followCube = nil
}

debug = false

function onLoad(save_state)
  if save_state ~= nil and save_state ~= "" then
    saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
  end
end

function onSave()
  return JSON.encode(saved_data)
end

function toggleOptions()
  if debug then
    local startPos = self.getPosition()

    -- Find Objects
    local castSize = self.getScale()
    castSize = { castSize.x * 18, 2, castSize.z * 18 }
    local objsToMove = Physics.cast({
      type = 3,
      origin = { startPos.x, saved_data["raise"] + 1, startPos.z },
      direction = { 0, 1, 0 },
      size = castSize,
      max_distance = 2,
      debug = debug
    })
  end

  if saved_data["heldBy"] ~= nil then
    return false
  end

  saved_data["options"] = not saved_data["options"]
  self.UI.setAttribute("optionsMenu", "active", saved_data["options"])
end

function resizePlatform(clicker, textValue, uiid)
  saved_data[uiid] = textValue

  local curPos = self.getPosition()
  self.setPosition({ curPos.x, saved_data["raise"], curPos.z })

  self.setScale({ saved_data["width"] / 10, 0.5, saved_data["height"] / 10 })
end

function showOverlay(clicker)
  if saved_data["heldBy"] ~= nil then
    return false
  end

  spawnObject({
    type = "BlockSquare",
    position = clicker.getPointerPosition(),
    scale = self.getScale(),
    sound = false,
    callback_function = function(obj)
      saved_data["followCube"] = obj.getGUID()
      obj.setLock(true)
      obj.setColorTint({ 0, 0, 0, 0 })
      setupOverlay(obj)
    end
  })

  saved_data["heldBy"] = clicker.color

  timerID = self.getGUID() .. math.random(9999999999999)
  Timer.create({
    identifier = timerID,
    function_name = "moveOverlay",
    function_owner = self,
    repetitions = 0,
    delay = 0.1
  })
end

function setupOverlay(obj)
  obj.UI.setXml([[
    <Panel
        id = "overlay"
        color = "#00990020"
        width = "1805"
        height = "1805"
        scale = "1 1 1"
        >
        <Button
            onClick = "]] .. self.getGUID() .. [[/movePlatform"
            color = "#00000000"
        />
    </Panel>
    ]])
end

function movePlatform()
  getObjectFromGUID(saved_data["followCube"]).destruct()
  local startPos = self.getPosition()

  -- Find Objects
  local castSize = self.getScale()
  castSize = { castSize.x * 18, 2, castSize.z * 18 }
  local objsToMove = Physics.cast({
    type = 3,
    origin = { startPos.x, saved_data["raise"] + 1, startPos.z },
    direction = { 0, 1, 0 },
    size = castSize,
    max_distance = 2,
    debug = debug
  })

  -- Move Platform
  local location = Player[saved_data["heldBy"]].getPointerPosition()
  self.setPosition({ location.x, saved_data["raise"], location.z })

  -- Move Objects
  Wait.frames(function()
    local objPosList = {}
    for _, objInfo in pairs(objsToMove) do
      local objPos = objInfo.hit_object.getPosition()
      local obj = objInfo.hit_object
      if obj ~= self then
        local xDiff = self.getPosition().x - startPos.x
        local yDiff = self.getPosition().y - startPos.y
        local zDiff = self.getPosition().z - startPos.z

        local newX = objPos.x + xDiff
        local newY = objPos.y + yDiff
        local newZ = objPos.z + zDiff
        objPos = { newX, newY, newZ }

        local lockState = obj.getLock()
        obj.setLock(true)
        obj.setPosition(objPos)
        Wait.frames(function() obj.setLock(lockState) end, 5)
      end
    end
  end, 5)

  -- Cleanup
  Timer.destroy(timerID)
  saved_data["heldBy"] = nil
  saved_data["followCube"] = nil
end

function moveOverlay()
  local location = Player[saved_data["heldBy"]].getPointerPosition()
  local cube = getObjectFromGUID(saved_data["followCube"])
  location = { location.x, saved_data["raise"], location.z }
  cube.setPositionSmooth(location, false, true)
end

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
-- The Music Box Tweaks by Shkaf
-- Original Music Box Steam page: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3114355269
-- Tweaked Music Box Steam page: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3292567962

--[[ VARIABLES --]]
config = {
  colours = {
    WHITE = { 1, 1, 1 },
    DARK = { 29 / 255, 29 / 255, 47 / 255 },
    GREEN = { 100 / 255, 200 / 255, 100 / 255 },
  },
}
local playlistName = ""
local audioclipTitle = ""
local cartridgeslotCheck = false
local emptyPlaylist = {
  title = "Not Playing",
  url = ""
}
local cartridges

--[[ EVENTS --]]
function onUpdate()
  onNewChip()
  onNewAudioclip()
end

function onNewChip()
  if (cartridges.length ~= "nil") then
    local cartridgeSlotPosition = self.positionToWorld(Vector(0, 0.2, -0.5333))

    cartridgeslotCheck = false
    for i, obj in ipairs(cartridges) do
      if (obj.getPosition() == cartridgeSlotPosition) then
        cartridgeslotCheck = true
        local cartridgeslotPlaylistName = obj.getName()
        if (playlistName ~= cartridgeslotPlaylistName) then
          playlistName = cartridgeslotPlaylistName
          setNewPlaylist(obj)
          break
        end
      end
    end

    if cartridgeslotCheck == false then
      clearPlaylist()
    end
  end
end

function setNewPlaylist(chip)
  local new_playlist = chip:getVar("playlist")
  MusicPlayer:setPlaylist(new_playlist)

  --second track playing fix
  if #new_playlist > 1 then
    MusicPlayer.playlistIndex = 0
    MusicPlayer:skipForward()
    go_to_zero()
  else
    MusicPlayer.playlistIndex = 0
    MusicPlayer:skipForward()
    MusicPlayer.repeat_track = true
  end

  update_panel()
end

function clearPlaylist()
  if playlistName ~= "" then
    MusicPlayer.pause()
    MusicPlayer:setPlaylist(emptyPlaylist)

    playlistName = ""
    MusicPlayer.shuffle = false
    MusicPlayer.repeat_track = false

    update_panel()
  end
end

function go_to_zero()
  if MusicPlayer.playlistIndex > 0 then
    MusicPlayer:skipBack()
    go_to_zero()
  end
end

function onNewAudioclip()
  local currentAudioclipTitle = MusicPlayer.getCurrentAudioclip().title
  if audioclipTitle ~= currentAudioclipTitle then
    audioclipTitle = currentAudioclipTitle
    update_panel()
  end
end

--Check for spawning new chips
function onObjectDestroy(object)
  cartridges = getObjectsWithTag("Music Cartridge")
end

function onObjectSpawn(object)
  cartridges = getObjectsWithTag("Music Cartridge")
end

function onLoad()
  cartridges = getObjectsWithTag("Music Cartridge")

  --Fix for playlist not loading
  if MusicPlayer.getCurrentAudioclip().title == "" then
    MusicPlayer.setCurrentAudioclip({
      url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2386431627382734789/A951A001D88ED036A9CDC3152F8EEA2766854AE3/",
      title = "Music Box Loaded"
    })
  end

  local text_params = {
    click_function = "dummy_button",
    function_owner = self,
    position       = { 0, 0.2, 0 },
    scale          = { 0.5, 1, 0.5 },
    width          = 0,
    height         = 0,
    font_size      = 100,
    font_color     = config.colours.WHITE
  }
  self:createButton(text_params)

  local button_params = {
    click_function = "dummy_button",
    function_owner = self,
    position       = { 0, 0.2, 0 },
    scale          = { 0.5, 1, 0.5 },
    width          = 150,
    height         = 150,
    font_size      = 300,
    color          = config.colours.DARK,
    font_color     = config.colours.WHITE
  }

  for i = 1, 5 do
    self:createButton(button_params)
  end
  self:editButton({ index = 1, click_function = "toggle_shuffle", position = { -1, 0.25, 0.55 }, tooltip = "Shuffle" })
  self:editButton({ index = 2, click_function = "back_button", position = { -0.5, 0.25, 0.55 }, width = 300, height = 300 })
  self:editButton({ index = 3, click_function = "play_button", text = "▶", position = { 0, 0.25, 0.55 }, width = 500, height = 500 })
  self:editButton({ index = 4, click_function = "forward_button", position = { 0.5, 0.25, 0.55 }, width = 300, height = 300 })
  self:editButton({ index = 5, click_function = "toggle_repeat", position = { 1, 0.25, 0.55 }, tooltip = "Repeat" })

  self:createButton(text_params)
  self:editButton({ index = 6, position = { 0, 0.2, 0.915 } })

  update_panel()
end

--[[ BUTTONS --]]
function toggle_shuffle()
  MusicPlayer.shuffle = not MusicPlayer.shuffle
  update_panel()
end

function back_button()
  if MusicPlayer.playlist_index > 0 then
    MusicPlayer:skipBack()
  end
  update_panel()
end

function play_button()
  if MusicPlayer.player_status ~= "Play" then
    MusicPlayer:play()
  elseif MusicPlayer.player_status == "Play" then
    MusicPlayer:pause()
  end
  update_panel()
end

function forward_button()
  if #MusicPlayer.getPlaylist() > 1 then
    MusicPlayer:skipForward()
  end
  update_panel()
end

function toggle_repeat()
  MusicPlayer.repeat_track = not MusicPlayer.repeat_track
  update_panel()
end

--[[ VISUALISATION --]]
function update_panel()
  Wait.frames(
    function()
      -- Now Playing Text
      local now_playing_label = audioclipTitle
      if cartridgeslotCheck == false then
        now_playing_label = "Paused - Please add a cartridge!"
      end
      self:editButton({ index = 0, label = now_playing_label })

      -- Shuffle Button
      local shuffle_button_colour = MusicPlayer.shuffle and config.colours.GREEN or config.colours.DARK
      self:editButton({ index = 1, color = shuffle_button_colour })

      -- Back Button
      local back_button_label, back_button_tooltip
      if MusicPlayer.playlist_index > 0 then
        back_button_label = "«"
        back_button_colour = config.colours.DARK
        back_button_tooltip = "Back"
      else
        back_button_label = nil
        back_button_colour = nil
        back_button_tooltip = ""
      end
      self:editButton({ index = 2, label = back_button_label, color = back_button_colour, tooltip = back_button_tooltip })

      -- Play/Pause Button
      local play_button_label, play_button_font_size, play_button_colour, play_button_tooltip
      if MusicPlayer.player_status == "Pause" then
        play_button_label = "▶"
        play_button_font_size = 300
        play_button_colour = config.colours.DARK
        play_button_tooltip = "Play"
      else
        play_button_label = "▐ ▌"
        play_button_font_size = 200
        play_button_colour = config.colours.GREEN
        play_button_tooltip = "Pause"
      end
      self:editButton({
        index = 3,
        label = play_button_label,
        font_size = play_button_font_size,
        color =
            play_button_colour,
        tooltip = play_button_tooltip
      })

      -- Forward Button
      local forward_button_label, forward_button_tooltip
      if #MusicPlayer.getPlaylist() > 1 then
        forward_button_label = "»"
        forward_button_colour = config.colours.DARK
        forward_button_tooltip = "Forward"
      else
        forward_button_label = nil
        forward_button_colour = nil
        forward_button_tooltip = ""
      end
      self:editButton({
        index = 4,
        label = forward_button_label,
        color = forward_button_colour,
        tooltip =
            forward_button_tooltip
      })

      -- Repeat Button
      local repeat_button_colour = MusicPlayer.repeat_track and config.colours.GREEN or config.colours.DARK
      self:editButton({ index = 5, color = repeat_button_colour })
    end,
    10
  )
end

ObjectStates.Name: Custom_Model_Bag
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
platformGUID = "eac4a2"
scriptZonePlaylists = "9c0c4c"

function onLoad()
  collectCartridges()
end

function collectCartridges()
  local zone = getObjectFromGUID(scriptZonePlaylists)
  if not zone then
    Wait.time(placeRandom, 1)
    return
  end

  local objects = zone.getObjects()
  local collected = 0
  for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
    if obj.hasTag("Music Cartridge") then
      collected = collected + 1
      self.putObject(obj)
    end
  end

  -- Wait for objects to settle in bag, then place new ones
  Wait.time(placeRandom, math.max(1, collected * 0.2))
end

function placeRandom()
  local platform = getObjectFromGUID(platformGUID)
  if not platform then
    --broadcastToAll("Platform not found!", { 1, 0.3, 0.3 })
    return
  end

  local snapPoints = platform.getSnapPoints()
  if not snapPoints or #snapPoints == 0 then
    --broadcastToAll("No snap points on platform!", { 1, 0.3, 0.3 })
    return
  end

  local bagObjects = self.getObjects()
  if #bagObjects == 0 then
    --broadcastToAll("Bag is empty!", { 1, 0.3, 0.3 })
    return
  end

  -- Collect GUIDs and shuffle for random selection
  local guids = {}
  for _, obj in ipairs(bagObjects) do
    guids[#guids + 1] = obj.guid
  end
  for i = #guids, 2, -1 do
    local j = math.random(1, i)
    guids[i], guids[j] = guids[j], guids[i]
  end

  local count = math.min(#snapPoints, #guids)

  for i = 1, count do
    Wait.time(function()
      local snap = snapPoints[i]
      local snapPos = platform.positionToWorld(snap.position)

      self.takeObject({
        guid = guids[i],
        position = { snapPos.x, snapPos.y + 0.5, snapPos.z },
        smooth = true
      })
    end, (i - 1) * 0.1)
  end
end

steamLink = 'https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3689375010'

function onLoad()
  self.setDescription(steamLink)

  self.createButton({
    click_function = 'showLink',
    function_owner = self,
    position = { 0, 0.1, 0 },
    width = 10,
    height = 10,
    scale = { 100, 100, 100 },
    color = { 1, 1, 1, 0 },
    hover_color = { 1, 1, 1, 0.25 },
    tooltip = 'Show Steam Workshop LINK'
  })
end

function showLink()
  self.createInput({
    input_function = 'null',
    function_owner = self,
    label = steamLink,
    position = { 0, 1, -1.5 },
    width = 4200,
    height = 170,
    font_size = 140,
    scale = { 2, 2, 2 },
    color = { 0.1, 0.1, 0.1 },
    font_color = { 1, 1, 1 },
    alignment = 3,
    value = steamLink,
    tooltip = 'ctrl-C'
  })

  self.clearButtons()

  self.createButton({
    click_function = 'hideLink',
    function_owner = self,
    position = { 0, 0.1, 0 },
    width = 10,
    height = 10,
    scale = { 100, 100, 100 },
    color = { 1, 1, 1, 0 },
    hover_color = { 1, 1, 1, 0.25 },
    tooltip = 'Hide Steam Workshop LINK'
  })

  wid = Wait.time(hideLink, 10)
end

function hideLink()
  if wid then
    Wait.stop(wid)
  end

  self.clearInputs()
  self.clearButtons()
  self.createButton({
    click_function = 'showLink',
    function_owner = self,
    position = { 0, 0.1, 0 },
    width = 10,
    height = 10,
    scale = { 100, 100, 100 },
    color = { 1, 1, 1, 0 },
    hover_color = { 1, 1, 1, 0.25 },
    tooltip = 'Show Steam Workshop LINK'
  })
end

function null()
end

-- Build label lookup from ALL_RANKS for click handler display
local RANK_LABELS = {}
for _, rank in ipairs(ALL_RANKS) do
  RANK_LABELS[rank.code] = rank.label
end

-- Dynamic click handlers for rank buttons (created once, reused across rebuilds)
local _rankClickFns = {}
local function getRankClickFunction(code)
  if _rankClickFns[code] then return _rankClickFns[code] end
  local fnName = "onRankClick_" .. code
  _G[fnName] = function(obj, playerColor)
    local desc = RANK_DESCRIPTIONS[code]
    if desc then
      local label = RANK_LABELS[code] or code
      local extended = Global.getVar("extendedValues") or false
      local sn = Global.getVar("sortNormal")
      if sn == nil then sn = true end
      local isReversed = not sn
      local longText = desc.long
      if extended and isReversed and desc.longExtendedReversed then
        longText = desc.longExtendedReversed
      elseif isReversed and desc.longReversed then
        longText = desc.longReversed
      elseif extended and desc.longExtended then
        longText = desc.longExtended
      end
      broadcastToColor(LANG(label), playerColor, { 1, 0.2, 0.2 })
      broadcastToColor(LANG(desc.short), playerColor, { 1, 0.85, 0.3 })
      broadcastToColor(LANG(longText), playerColor, { 0.75, 0.75, 0.75 })
    end
  end
  _rankClickFns[code] = fnName
  return fnName
end

local function cardDisplayText(suit, value)
  local info = SUIT[suit]
  if not info then return "?" end
  if suit == "W" then return info.symbol end -- wild -> just "star"
  return info.symbol .. value                -- normal -> "spadeA", "heart10"
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Combinatorial probability engine
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function comb(n, k)
  if k < 0 or k > n then return 0 end
  if k == 0 or k == n then return 1 end
  if k > n - k then k = n - k end
  local r = 1
  for i = 0, k - 1 do
    r = r * (n - i) / (i + 1)
  end
  return math.floor(r + 0.5)
end

-- Read current deck parameters from Global
local function getDeckParams()
  local rainbowOn  = Global.getVar("rainbowActive") or false
  local extended   = Global.getVar("extendedValues") or false
  local blanked    = Global.getVar("blankedValue")
  local challenges = Global.getTable("activeChallenges")

  -- S reflects actual deck composition: Gear suit is always present when GRINDING_GEARS is active,
  -- regardless of the rainbow rank toggle (rainbowActive). Toggle only suppresses RB/SR ranks.
  local gearActive = challenges and challenges.GRINDING_GEARS or false
  local S          = gearActive and 5 or 4

  local V          = 13
  if Global.getVar("shortDeck") then V = V - 4 end -- Short Deck: 2-5 removed (6-A = 9 values)
  if extended then V = V + 3 end                   -- B, C, D
  if blanked then V = V - 1 end                    -- one value removed

  local W = 0
  if challenges and challenges.MASTER_KEY then W = challenges.MASTER_KEY end

  return S, V, W, rainbowOn
end

local function buildDeckSnapshot()
  local S, V, W, rainbowOn = getDeckParams()
  local flushActive = Global.getVar("flushActive")
  if flushActive == nil then flushActive = true end
  local sortNormal = Global.getVar("sortNormal")
  if sortNormal == nil then sortNormal = true end
  local shortDeck = Global.getVar("shortDeck") or false
  -- Include the live per-round card counts so the board re-renders as cards are dealt/revealed.
  local cc = Global.call("getHandRankRefCardCounts")
  local kPart = ""
  if type(cc) == "table" then kPart = "," .. tostring(cc.sel) .. (cc.hand or 0) .. "_" .. (cc.comm or 0) end
  return S ..
      "," .. V .. "," .. W .. "," .. tostring(rainbowOn) .. "," .. tostring(flushActive) .. "," .. tostring(sortNormal)
      .. "," .. tostring(shortDeck) .. kPart
end

-- Exact 5-card poker probabilities parameterized by S suits, V values,
-- W wild cards, and whether Rainbow ranks are active.
-- Returns { code = percentage, ... }
local function computeProbabilities(S, V, W, rainbowOn)
  local n     = S * V
  local N     = n + W
  local total = comb(N, 5)
  if total == 0 then return {} end

  local numStraights = (V >= 5) and (V - 3) or 0

  -- Base hand counts (from n natural cards, choosing 5)
  local c = {}
  c["5s"] = comb(S, 5) * V
  c["RF"] = (V >= 5) and S or 0
  c["SF"] = (V >= 5) and (S * (V - 4)) or 0
  c["4s"] = V * comb(S, 4) * S * (V - 1)
  c["FH"] = V * comb(S, 3) * (V - 1) * comb(S, 2)
  c["FL"] = S * (comb(V, 5) - ((V >= 5) and (V - 3) or 0))
  c["ST"] = numStraights * (S ^ 5 - S)
  c["3s"] = V * comb(S, 3) * comb(V - 1, 2) * S ^ 2
  c["2p"] = comb(V, 2) * comb(S, 2) ^ 2 * (V - 2) * S
  c["1p"] = V * comb(S, 2) * comb(V - 1, 3) * S ^ 3
  c["RB"] = 0
  c["SR"] = 0

  -- Rainbow ranks (only with 5 suits)
  if S == 5 and rainbowOn then
    c["SR"]         = numStraights * 120         -- 5! suit permutations per straight
    c["ST"]         = c["ST"] - c["SR"]          -- remove SR from regular straights

    local allFive   = V ^ 5                      -- all 5-suit hands
    local fiveK_5s  = V                          -- five-of-a-kind with 5 suits
    local fourK_5s  = V * 5 * (V - 1)            -- four-of-a-kind with 5 suits
    local fh_5s     = V * 10 * (V - 1)           -- full house
    local threeK_5s = V * 10 * (V - 1) * (V - 2) -- three-of-a-kind
    c["RB"]         = allFive - fiveK_5s - fourK_5s - fh_5s - threeK_5s - c["SR"]

    -- Subtract 5-suit overlaps from lower ranks (they become Rainbow)
    local twoP_5s   = comb(V, 2) * 10 * 3 * (V - 2)
    local oneP_5s   = V * 10 * (V - 1) * (V - 2) * (V - 3)
    c["2p"]         = c["2p"] - twoP_5s
    c["1p"]         = c["1p"] - oneP_5s
  end

  -- High Card = remainder
  local sumOther = 0
  for _, code in ipairs({ "5s", "RF", "SF", "4s", "SR", "FH", "FL", "ST", "3s", "RB", "2p", "1p" }) do
    sumOther = sumOther + c[code]
  end
  c["HC"] = comb(n, 5) - sumOther

  -- Wild card adjustment (simplified upgrade model)
  if W > 0 then
    local probNoWild   = comb(n, 5) / total
    local probWild     = 1 - probNoWild
    local total4       = comb(n, 4)

    -- 4-natural-card pattern counts -> what they upgrade to with 1 wild
    -- Group-based upgrades (always the best choice within their tier)
    local fourK_4      = V * comb(S, 4)                          -- -> 5s
    local threeK_4     = V * comb(S, 3) * (V - 1) * S            -- -> 4s
    local twoP_4       = comb(V, 2) * comb(S, 2) ^ 2             -- -> FH
    local oneP_4       = V * comb(S, 2) * comb(V - 1, 2) * S ^ 2 -- -> 3s
    local hc_4         = total4 - fourK_4 - threeK_4 - twoP_4 - oneP_4

    -- HC hands split: same-suit -> FL/SF/RF, straight draws -> ST, rest -> 1p
    -- (1P/2P/3K/4K can't make flushes or straights with 1 wild)
    local straightSubs = (V >= 5) and math.min(math.max(0, 4 * V - 11), comb(V, 4)) or 0
    local royalSubs    = (V >= 5) and math.min(5, straightSubs) or 0
    local rf_draw4     = S * royalSubs                   -- same suit, royal window -> RF
    local sf_draw4     = S * (straightSubs - royalSubs)  -- same suit, other straight -> SF
    local fl_draw4     = S * (comb(V, 4) - straightSubs) -- same suit, no straight -> FL
    local st_draw4     = straightSubs * (S ^ 4 - S)      -- multi-suit straight draw -> ST

    -- Rainbow upgrades (5 suits): 4 different suits + wild completes all 5 -> RB or SR
    local sr_draw4     = 0
    local rb_draw4     = 0
    if S == 5 and rainbowOn then
      local permV4      = V * (V - 1) * (V - 2) * (V - 3)
      local stInRainbow = math.min(straightSubs * 24, permV4)
      sr_draw4          = comb(S, 4) * stInRainbow            -- 4 diff suits, straight -> SR
      rb_draw4          = comb(S, 4) * (permV4 - stInRainbow) -- 4 diff suits, no straight -> RB
      st_draw4          = st_draw4 - sr_draw4                 -- remove from multi-suit ST count
    end

    local hc_4_rest = hc_4 - rf_draw4 - sf_draw4 - fl_draw4 - st_draw4 - sr_draw4 - rb_draw4

    local up        = {
      ["5s"] = fourK_4 / total4,
      ["RF"] = rf_draw4 / total4,
      ["SF"] = sf_draw4 / total4,
      ["4s"] = threeK_4 / total4,
      ["SR"] = sr_draw4 / total4,
      ["FH"] = twoP_4 / total4,
      ["FL"] = fl_draw4 / total4,
      ["ST"] = st_draw4 / total4,
      ["3s"] = oneP_4 / total4,
      ["RB"] = rb_draw4 / total4,
      ["1p"] = hc_4_rest / total4,
    }

    local baseTotal = comb(n, 5)
    for code, count in pairs(c) do
      local pBase = count / baseTotal
      local pUp   = up[code] or 0
      c[code]     = (probNoWild * pBase + probWild * pUp) * total
    end
  end

  -- Convert to percentages
  local probs = {}
  for code, count in pairs(c) do
    probs[code] = (count / total) * 100
  end
  return probs
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Cascade: when a rank is blocked, hands that would qualify fall through
-- to the next-best rank they also satisfy (mirrors findBestHandRank).
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local CASCADE = {
  ["5s"] = "4s", -- 5K > 4K
  ["RF"] = "SF", -- Royal Flush is a Straight Flush
  ["SF"] = "FL", -- Straight Flush is a Flush (FL > ST in priority)
  ["4s"] = "3s", -- 4K > 3K
  ["SR"] = "ST", -- Straight Rainbow is a Straight (ST > RB in priority)
  ["FH"] = "3s", -- Full House = triple + pair -> falls to triple
  ["FL"] = "HC", -- pure Flush has no groups -> High Card
  ["ST"] = "HC", -- pure Straight has no groups -> High Card
  ["3s"] = "1p", -- 3K > pair
  ["RB"] = "HC", -- Rainbow = all different suits, no groups -> HC
  ["2p"] = "1p", -- Two Pair > One Pair
  ["1p"] = "HC", -- One Pair -> High Card
}

-- Derive priority order from global HAND_RANKS registry (excluding B0)
local PRIORITY_ORDER = {}
do
  local ranks = Global.getTable("HAND_RANKS") or {}
  for _, rank in ipairs(ranks) do
    if rank.code ~= "B0" then
      PRIORITY_ORDER[#PRIORITY_ORDER + 1] = rank.code
    end
  end
end

-- Follow cascade chain until reaching an unblocked rank
local function findCascadeTarget(code, blocked)
  local visited = {}
  local current = code
  while blocked[current] and CASCADE[current] do
    visited[current] = true
    current = CASCADE[current]
    if visited[current] then break end
  end
  return current
end

-- Redistribute blocked ranks' probability to their cascade targets
local function applyBlockedCascade(probs, blocked)
  for _, code in ipairs(PRIORITY_ORDER) do
    if blocked[code] and probs[code] and probs[code] > 0 then
      local target = findCascadeTarget(code, blocked)
      if target ~= code then
        probs[target] = (probs[target] or 0) + probs[code]
      end
      probs[code] = 0
    end
  end
end

-- A challenge value may be a stack count (number) or a boolean flag.
local function challengeCount(v)
  if type(v) == "number" then return v end
  return v and 1 or 0
end

-- Value-profile letter for the config key.
local function currentVProf()
  if Global.getVar("shortDeck") then return "S" end
  if Global.getVar("extendedValues") then return "E" end
  return "N"
end

-- Current generic card counts, used per round (live: updates as cards are dealt/revealed).
-- Prefers the Global helper (counts the actual dealt + revealed cards); falls back to deriving
-- the SHOWDOWN counts from active challenges if the helper is unavailable.
-- Returns "H", k  (Hold'em)  or  "O", hole, board  (Omaha).
local function currentCardCounts()
  local c = Global.call("getHandRankRefCardCounts")
  if type(c) == "table" then
    if c.sel == "O" then return "O", c.hand or 4, c.comm or 0 end
    return "H", (c.hand or 2) + (c.comm or 0)
  end
  local ch = Global.getTable("activeChallenges") or {}
  local flags = Global.getTable("FLAGS") or {}
  local omaha = flags.Omaha or false
  local handAdd = challengeCount(ch.SECURITY_CAMERA)
  local commAdd = challengeCount(ch.UNINVITED_GUEST) + challengeCount(ch.LENGTHY_FINISH)
      + challengeCount(ch.ROUGH_KICKOFF) + challengeCount(ch.FOOT_DOOR)
  local balance = challengeCount(ch.BALANCE) > 0 and 1 or 0
  local hand = (omaha and 4 or 2) + handAdd - balance
  local board = 5 + commAdd
  if omaha then return "O", hand, board end
  return "H", hand + board
end

-- Config key, matching tools/poker7_sweep.lua.
local function bakedConfigKey(S, W)
  local vprof = currentVProf()
  local sel, a, b = currentCardCounts()
  if sel == "O" then
    return string.format("O_S%dV%s_W%d_H%d_B%d", S, vprof, W, a, b)
  end
  return string.format("H_S%dV%s_W%d_K%d", S, vprof, W, a)
end

-- Decode a baked config into { code = pct } via max(capabilities \ locked) by the active priority
-- (this is the capability-set lock model, so it also replaces applyBlockedCascade exactly).
-- Returns nil when this config hasn't been baked, so the caller can fall back.
local function bakedProbs(S, W, locked)
  if not HANDRANK_PROB then return nil end
  local flat = HANDRANK_PROB.configs[bakedConfigKey(S, W)]
  if not flat then return nil end
  local codes = HANDRANK_PROB.codes
  local prio = Global.call("getHandRankPriority") or {}
  local probs = {}
  for i = 1, #flat, 2 do
    local mask, pct = flat[i], flat[i + 1]
    local best, bestP
    for b = 1, #codes do
      if math.floor(mask / 2 ^ (b - 1)) % 2 >= 1 then
        local c = codes[b]
        if not (locked and locked[c]) then
          local p = prio[c] or -1
          if not bestP or p > bestP then
            bestP = p; best = c
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if best then probs[best] = (probs[best] or 0) + pct end
  end
  return probs
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Build / rebuild all buttons
------------------------------------------------------------------------
function buildButtons()
  self.clearButtons()

  local S, V, W, rainbowOn = getDeckParams()
  local rainbowActive      = rainbowOn
  local flushActive        = Global.getVar("flushActive")
  if flushActive == nil then flushActive = true end

  -- CPU mode: percentages are only shown for Hand Rank (2) and Full (3). Disabled (0) and
  -- Low Calc (1) hide the percentage column entirely (the rank rows + example cards still show).
  local cpuMode     = Global.getVar("cpuMode") or 2
  local showPercent = cpuMode >= 2

  -- Build effective blocked set: lockedHandRanks + force-locks from challenge flags
  local lockedRanks = Global.getTable("lockedHandRanks") or {}
  if not flushActive then
    lockedRanks["FL"] = true
    lockedRanks["SF"] = true
    lockedRanks["RF"] = true
  end
  if not rainbowActive then
    lockedRanks["RB"] = true
    lockedRanks["SR"] = true
  end

  -- Percentages. Full mode (cpuMode 3) uses the LIVE board-conditional engine
  -- (Global.getBoardRankProbs): it enumerates the unknown hole cards for the CURRENT board, so
  -- impossible ranks come out at exactly 0% (covering both the floor and the ceiling) and Intricate
  -- Lock / flush / rainbow locks are handled by construction. It returns nil for Omaha and any
  -- unsupported config, in which case we fall back to the baked generic table. Hand Rank mode
  -- (cpuMode 2) always uses the baked table + the (ceiling-only) reachability gate.
  -- Full mode reads the ASYNC cache (Global computes it on a coroutine so it never freezes the
  -- client). The cache may be nil (first compute in flight) or hold the previous board's values for
  -- ~1-2s while a recompute runs -- intended: previous values stay visible until the new ones land.
  local probs, liveProbs
  if cpuMode == 3 then
    liveProbs = Global.call("getBoardProbsCached")
    probs = liveProbs
  end
  if not probs then
    probs = bakedProbs(S, W, lockedRanks)
    if not probs then
      probs = computeProbabilities(S, V, W, rainbowOn)
      applyBlockedCascade(probs, lockedRanks)
    end
  end

  -- Physical reachability on the ACTUAL current board (best-case hole cards). A rank that is
  -- statistically possible but can't be formed from the cards on the table right now -- e.g. a
  -- flush when the revealed community can never yield 5 of one suit -- renders "—" instead of a
  -- misleading %. nil (older Global without the helper) means "don't gate" -> show the % as before.
  -- With live probs we TRUST the exact engine (a 0%/absent rank already shows "—") and skip this
  -- heuristic gate so it can never over-block a rank the live engine deems reachable.
  local reachable = nil
  if not liveProbs then
    reachable = Global.call("getReachableHandRanks")
  end

  -- Collect only the ranks that should be visible right now
  local visible = {}
  for _, rank in ipairs(ALL_RANKS) do
    local show = true
    -- A rank is hidden only when it is actually disabled: a rainbow-only rank with
    -- rainbow off, or a locked rank (Intricate Lock / No Color). A reachable-but-0%
    -- rank stays visible and renders "—" via the probability label below.
    if rank.rainbow and not rainbowActive then show = false end
    if lockedRanks[rank.code] then show = false end
    if show then
      visible[#visible + 1] = rank
    end
  end

  -- Read state flags for card display
  local extendedValues = Global.getVar("extendedValues") or false
  local shortDeckOn = Global.getVar("shortDeck") or false
  local sortNormal = Global.getVar("sortNormal")
  if sortNormal == nil then sortNormal = true end
  local reversed = not sortNormal

  -- Priority from global HAND_RANKS registry (single source of truth)
  local displayPriority = Global.call("getHandRankPriority") or {}
  table.sort(visible, function(a, b)
    return (displayPriority[a.code] or 0) > (displayPriority[b.code] or 0)
  end)

  -- Center rows vertically around Z = 0
  local totalHeight = (#visible - 1) * LAYOUT.rowSpacing
  local startZ = -totalHeight / 2

  -- Header (clickable -- opens quick reference UI panel)
  self.createButton({
    click_function = "onHeaderClick",
    function_owner = self,
    label          = LANG(STRINGS.HEADER_HAND_RANKS),
    position       = { 0, BUTTON_Y, startZ + LAYOUT.header.offsetZ },
    width          = 2000,
    height         = 250,
    font_size      = LAYOUT.header.fontSize,
    color          = { 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 1 },
    font_color     = LAYOUT.header.fontColor,
    tooltip        = LANG(STRINGS.TOOLTIP_QUICK_REFERENCE),
  })

  -- Compute X positions from widths so rank + cards stay aligned
  -- TTS button units ~ 1 unit per ~500 button-width units (approximate)
  local SCALE       = 1 / 500
  local rankHalfW   = LAYOUT.rank.width * SCALE / 2
  local cardHalfW   = LAYOUT.card.width * SCALE / 2
  local cardSpacing = LAYOUT.card.spacing
  local totalCardsW = cardHalfW + (4 * cardSpacing) + cardHalfW -- edge-to-edge of 5 cards
  local probGap     = LAYOUT.prob.gap
  local totalRowW   = rankHalfW * 2 + LAYOUT.gap + totalCardsW + probGap + 0.6
  local leftEdge    = -totalRowW / 2
  local rankX       = leftEdge + rankHalfW
  local firstCardX  = leftEdge + rankHalfW * 2 + LAYOUT.gap + cardHalfW
  local probX       = firstCardX + 4 * cardSpacing + cardHalfW + probGap

  -- One row per visible rank
  for row, rank in ipairs(visible) do
    local z = startZ + (row - 1) * LAYOUT.rowSpacing

    -- Rank name button (dark bg, gold text -- click for description)
    self.createButton({
      click_function = getRankClickFunction(rank.code),
      function_owner = self,
      label          = LANG(rank.label),
      position       = { rankX, BUTTON_Y, z },
      width          = LAYOUT.rank.width,
      height         = LAYOUT.rank.height,
      font_size      = LAYOUT.rank.fontSize,
      color          = LAYOUT.rank.bgColor,
      font_color     = LAYOUT.rank.fontColor,
      tooltip        = "",
    })

    -- 5 example cards, by active combo (none ever uses a card < 6 under Short Deck):
    --   Short Deck + Quantum -> reversedShortDeck (reversed flavour, 6-A values)
    --   Short Deck           -> shortDeck
    --   Quantum (reversed)   -> reversed
    --   default              -> cards
    -- Fallbacks cover ranks whose default/reversed sets are already >= 6 (e.g. 5s, ST).
    local displayCards = rank.cards
    if shortDeckOn and reversed then
      displayCards = rank.reversedShortDeck or rank.reversed or rank.cards
    elseif shortDeckOn then
      displayCards = rank.shortDeck or rank.cards
    elseif reversed and rank.reversed then
      displayCards = rank.reversed
    end
    for i, card in ipairs(displayCards) do
      local suit, value = card[1], card[2]
      -- Override RF example cards when Extra (extendedValues) is active
      if rank.code == "RF" and extendedValues and not reversed then
        local rfExt = { { "S", "Ð" }, { "S", "Ç" }, { "S", "ß" }, { "S", "A" }, { "S", "K" } }
        suit, value = rfExt[i][1], rfExt[i][2]
      end
      local info      = SUIT[suit]
      local isWild    = (suit == "W")
      local isKicker  = rank.kickers[i]

      local fontColor = isKicker and KICKER_FONT
          or (info and info.color or { 1, 1, 1, 1 })
      local bgColor   = isKicker and KICKER_BG
          or (isWild and LAYOUT.card.wildBgColor
            or LAYOUT.card.bgColor)

      self.createButton({
        click_function = "doNothing",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = cardDisplayText(suit, value),
        position       = {
          firstCardX + (i - 1) * cardSpacing,
          BUTTON_Y,
          z,
        },
        width          = LAYOUT.card.width,
        height         = LAYOUT.card.height,
        font_size      = LAYOUT.card.fontSize,
        color          = bgColor,
        font_color     = fontColor,
        tooltip        = "",
      })
    end

    -- Probability label. A rank that is physically unreachable on the current board shows "—"
    -- regardless of its statistical %; reachable == nil means the gate is unavailable (show %).
    -- Skipped entirely in Disabled / Low Calc CPU modes (showPercent false).
    if showPercent then
      local pct = probs[rank.code]
      local probLabel
      if reachable and not reachable[rank.code] then
        probLabel = "—"
      elseif pct and pct >= 0.01 then
        probLabel = string.format("%.2f%%", pct)
      elseif pct and pct > 0 then
        probLabel = string.format("%.3f‰", pct * 10)
      else
        probLabel = "—"
      end
      self.createButton({
        click_function = "doNothing",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = probLabel,
        position       = { probX, BUTTON_Y, z },
        width          = 0,
        height         = 0,
        font_size      = LAYOUT.prob.fontSize,
        font_color     = LAYOUT.prob.fontColor,
        tooltip        = "",
      })
    end
  end
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lifecycle
------------------------------------------------------------------------
function onLoad()
  lastRainbowState      = Global.getVar("rainbowActive") or false
  lastLockedSnapshot    = buildLockedSnapshot()
  lastDeckSnapshot      = buildDeckSnapshot()
  lastCpuMode           = Global.getVar("cpuMode") or 2
  lastBoardProbsVersion = Global.getVar("boardProbsVersion") or 0
  buildButtons()
  -- Poll every 2 s so the board reacts to challenge changes
  Wait.time(checkForChanges, 2, -1)
end

-- Build a deterministic string from locked ranks for change detection
function buildLockedSnapshot()
  local locked = Global.getTable("lockedHandRanks") or {}
  local keys = {}
  for k in pairs(locked) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end
  table.sort(keys)
  return table.concat(keys, ",")
end

-- Called by Global (notifyBoardProbsReady) the instant a coroutine finishes a recompute, so the
-- board updates immediately instead of waiting for the next 2s poll. Syncs the version so the poll
-- in checkForChanges doesn't redundantly rebuild.
function refreshBoardProbsNow()
  lastBoardProbsVersion = Global.getVar("boardProbsVersion") or 0
  buildButtons()
end

function checkForChanges()
  local changed        = false
  local currentRainbow = Global.getVar("rainbowActive") or false
  local currentLocked  = buildLockedSnapshot()
  if currentRainbow ~= lastRainbowState then
    lastRainbowState = currentRainbow
    changed = true
  end
  if currentLocked ~= lastLockedSnapshot then
    lastLockedSnapshot = currentLocked
    changed = true
  end
  local currentDeck = buildDeckSnapshot()
  if currentDeck ~= lastDeckSnapshot then
    lastDeckSnapshot = currentDeck
    changed = true
  end
  local currentCpuMode = Global.getVar("cpuMode") or 2
  if currentCpuMode ~= lastCpuMode then
    lastCpuMode = currentCpuMode
    changed = true
  end
  -- Async board-% cache landed (the coroutine bumped the version) -> redraw with fresh numbers.
  local currentProbsVersion = Global.getVar("boardProbsVersion") or 0
  if currentProbsVersion ~= lastBoardProbsVersion then
    lastBoardProbsVersion = currentProbsVersion
    changed = true
  end
  if changed then
    buildButtons()
    Global.call("refreshHandRankInfoPanels")
  end
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Dynamic click function cache
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local _clickFns = {}

local function getClickFunction(feature)
  if _clickFns[feature.name] then return _clickFns[feature.name] end

  local fnName = "onInfoClick_" .. feature.name

  _G[fnName] = function(_, playerColor)
    -- Broadcast description
    broadcastToColor(LANG(feature.label), playerColor, { 1, 0.2, 0.2 })
    broadcastToColor(LANG(feature.desc), playerColor, { 1, 0.85, 0.3 })
    broadcastToColor(LANG(feature.info), playerColor, { 0.75, 0.75, 0.75 })

    -- Ping related objects
    if feature.pingGUIDs then
      for _, guidKey in ipairs(feature.pingGUIDs) do
        local guid = Global.getVar(guidKey)
        if guid then
          local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
          if obj then
            local pos = obj.getPosition()
            if Player[playerColor] and Player[playerColor].seated then
              Player[playerColor].pingTable(pos)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    -- Custom ping logic
    if feature.pingFn then
      feature.pingFn(playerColor)
    end
  end

  _clickFns[feature.name] = fnName
  return fnName
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Close button
------------------------------------------------------------------------
function stow()
  self.setPositionSmooth(POS_STOWED, false, false)
end

function onInfoClose(_, _)
  self.setPositionSmooth(POS_STOWED, false, false)
  self.clearButtons()
  buildMinimizedButton()
end

function onInfoOpen(_, _)
  --self.setPositionSmooth(POS_CENTER, false, false)
  self.setPositionSmooth(POS_STOWED, false, false)
  self.clearButtons()
  buildButtons()
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- No-op for label-only buttons
------------------------------------------------------------------------
function doNothing() end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Build minimized state (single "i" button)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
function buildMinimizedButton()
  self.createButton({
    click_function = "onInfoOpen",
    function_owner = self,
    label          = "i",
    position       = { 0, BUTTON_Y, 0 },
    width          = 350,
    height         = 350,
    font_size      = 250,
    color          = LAYOUT.close.bgColor,
    font_color     = LAYOUT.close.fontColor,
    tooltip        = LANG(STRINGS.TOOLTIP_SHOW_INFO),
  })
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
function buildButtons()
  self.clearButtons()

  local cols     = LAYOUT.columns
  local colWidth = (LAYOUT.totalWidth - (cols - 1) * LAYOUT.columnGap) / cols
  local startX   = -LAYOUT.totalWidth / 2 + colWidth / 2
  local startZ   = LAYOUT.headerOffsetZ + LAYOUT.rowSpacing

  -- Header
  self.createButton({
    click_function = "doNothing",
    function_owner = self,
    label          = LANG(STRINGS.HEADER_GAME_INFO),
    position       = { 0, BUTTON_Y, LAYOUT.headerOffsetZ },
    width          = 0,
    height         = 0,
    font_size      = LAYOUT.header.fontSize,
    font_color     = LAYOUT.header.fontColor,
  })

  -- Close button (top-right)
  self.createButton({
    click_function = "onInfoClose",
    function_owner = self,
    label          = "X",
    position       = { LAYOUT.totalWidth / 2 - 0.15, BUTTON_Y, LAYOUT.headerOffsetZ },
    width          = LAYOUT.close.width,
    height         = LAYOUT.close.height,
    font_size      = LAYOUT.close.fontSize,
    color          = LAYOUT.close.bgColor,
    font_color     = LAYOUT.close.fontColor,
    tooltip        = LANG(STRINGS.TOOLTIP_CLOSE_INFO),
  })

  -- Feature buttons in grid
  for idx, feature in ipairs(FEATURES) do
    local col   = (idx - 1) % cols
    local row   = math.floor((idx - 1) / cols)
    local x     = startX + col * (colWidth + LAYOUT.columnGap)
    local z     = startZ + row * LAYOUT.rowSpacing

    local isNew = feature.isNew
    self.createButton({
      click_function = getClickFunction(feature),
      function_owner = self,
      label          = (isNew and "★ " or "") .. LANG(feature.label),
      position       = { x, BUTTON_Y, z },
      width          = LAYOUT.button.width,
      height         = LAYOUT.button.height,
      font_size      = LAYOUT.button.fontSize,
      color          = isNew and LAYOUT.button.newBgColor or LAYOUT.button.bgColor,
      font_color     = isNew and LAYOUT.button.newFontColor or LAYOUT.button.fontColor,
      tooltip        = LANG(feature.desc),
    })
  end
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lifecycle
------------------------------------------------------------------------
function onLoad()
  self.setPosition(POS_CENTER)
  buildButtons()
end

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
-------------------------------------------------------------------
--- THE GANG - Coop Texas Hold'em
--- 1-10 Players
--- Stats Book LUA Script  ("The Gang Sense" accuracy stats)
--- Author: buckeT.de (https://steamcommunity.com/id/buckeTde/)
--- Version: 0.3 (2026-06-18)
-------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Stats Book — DATA TIER ONLY (this baseline)
--
-- Owns the per-game accuracy records, the merge/dedup logic, and
-- persistence. Scoring lives in global.lua (the producer); the
-- presentation overlay is added in a later slice.
--
-- This script must stay self-contained: a host can spawn their saved
-- career book on ANY table, so storage/merge must work without global.lua.
-- The only cross-script dependency is LANG for localized UI text later.
--
-- Communication (see FEATURE_IDEAS.md → Chip Placement Accuracy Score):
--   global.lua  →  book : book.call("recordGame", gameRecord)   (push at showdown)
--   book        →  book : bookB.call("exportGames")             (merge: read another book)
--   book        →  global : Global.call("LANG_CALL", { entry }) (localized text, later)
--
-- Object discovery: career books are Saved Objects and spawn with NEW
-- GUIDs, so they are found by GMNotes/tag ("StatsBook"), never a fixed GUID.
------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- GMNotes value used to discover every stats book on the table for merging.
-- Both the in-scene session book and saved career books carry this in GMNotes.
local BOOK_GMNOTES    = "StatsBook"

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- State
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- games[gameId] = {
--   ts      = <unix time>,            -- for sorting / rolling-window cap
--   date    = "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM",
--   players = {
--     [steamId] = {
--       name   = "...",
--       rounds = { [1] = { score, chip, n, srank }, [2] = {...}, [3] = {...}, [4] = {...} }
--     }, ...
--   }
-- }
games                 = {}

-- gameIds recorded during THIS runtime (vs loaded-from-save = career history).
-- Not persisted: on reload, everything from the save counts as career, not session.
local sessionIds      = {}

-- Cached serialized save state. TTS calls onSave() periodically (autosave / undo
-- snapshots), and re-encoding the whole games table (100+ games, ~170 KB) every time
-- blocks the main thread for a beat — the ~4-5s microstutter hosts noticed. We encode
-- once and reuse it until games actually changes (invalidateSaveCache on every mutation).
local cachedSaveState = nil
local function invalidateSaveCache() cachedSaveState = nil end

-- Optional cap on stored games (oldest pruned by ts). 0 = unbounded.
local MAX_GAMES        = 0

-- Minimum games before a player can rank among the qualified leaders. Players below this
-- are still listed, but always sorted beneath everyone who has reached it (so a single
-- perfect game can't outrank a long, near-perfect record).
local MIN_RANKED_GAMES = 10

-- Round weights for the weighted game-accuracy aggregate (R1..R4). R4 = 50% of a
-- full game, matching the producer's design. Tune here to re-score all history.
local ROUND_WEIGHTS    = { 1, 2, 3, 6 }

-- Tier thresholds by rating % — highest matching floor wins (tunable).
local TIERS            = {
  { floor = 85, label = "Mastermind" },
  { floor = 60, label = "Dealer" },
  { floor = 0,  label = "Rookie" },
}

-- Book face: at-a-glance leaderboard rendered as object buttons on the book itself.
-- Positions are in the book's LOCAL space. Because the book is rotated, on the
-- visible cover: local X = top↔bottom (rows stack along it), local Z = left↔right,
-- local Y = height above the cover. Tune to your object's size.
local FACE_MAX_ROWS    = 5
local FACE_Y           = -0.4 -- height above the cover
local FACE_COL_Z       = 0    -- left-right position of the column (0 = centered)
local FACE_TITLE_X     = 1.5  -- top of the cover (title sits here)
local FACE_ROW_X0      = 1    -- first leaderboard row (just below the title)
local FACE_ROW_DX      = -0.5 -- step per row; negative = rows descend down the cover
local FACE_TITLE_FONT  = 160
local FACE_ROW_FONT    = 110
local FACE_TITLE_COLOR = { 1, 0.85, 0.3 }
local FACE_ROW_COLOR   = { 1, 1, 1 }
local FACE_DIM_COLOR   = { 0.7, 0.7, 0.7 }
-- Button rotation is LOCAL (composed with the object's rest rotation), so to get
-- flat, readable text it must be the INVERSE of the book's rest orientation
-- {0,90,180} → {0,-90,180}. If text is still rotated/flipped, adjust one axis at a
-- time by ±90 (yaw) or ±180 (flip) and Save & Play.
local FACE_ROTATION    = { 0, 270, 180 }
-- Clickable scope toggle (Session/Career) shown where the title sits. Unlike the
-- label rows (width/height 0), this needs a positive clickable area — tune to taste.
local FACE_TOGGLE_W    = 1400
local FACE_TOGGLE_H    = 320

-- Which scope the book face shows; toggled by clicking the header on the cover.
local faceScope        = "session" -- "session" | "career"

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Persistence
--
-- A Saved Object restores its LuaScriptState into onLoad(saveState) when
-- spawned, so "Save Object" on the host's machine carries the games map
-- across sessions. onSave() is called when the table/object is saved.
------------------------------------------------------------------------
function onLoad(saveState)
  games = {}
  if saveState and saveState ~= "" then
    local ok, decoded = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(saveState) end)
    if ok and type(decoded) == "table" and type(decoded.games) == "table" then
      games = decoded.games
    end
  end
  -- Self-tag so global.lua and other books can discover this object by GMNotes,
  -- and so saved career books (which spawn with fresh GUIDs) are always found.
  self.setGMNotes(BOOK_GMNOTES)
  setupDebugMenu()
  updateBookFace()
end

function onSave()
  if cachedSaveState == nil then
    cachedSaveState = JSON.encode({ games = games })
  end
  return cachedSaveState
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Core: record + merge (dedup by gameId)
------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Validate the minimum shape of an incoming record.
local function isValidRecord(record)
  if type(record) ~= "table" then return false end
  if type(record.gameId) ~= "string" or record.gameId == "" then return false end
  if type(record.players) ~= "table" then return false end
  return true
end

-- Drop oldest games beyond MAX_GAMES (by ts ascending). No-op if unbounded.
local function pruneToCap()
  if MAX_GAMES <= 0 then return end
  local ids = {}
  for id, rec in pairs(games) do
    table.insert(ids, { id = id, ts = rec.ts or 0 })
  end
  if #ids <= MAX_GAMES then return end
  table.sort(ids, function(a, b) return a.ts < b.ts end)
  for i = 1, #ids - MAX_GAMES do
    games[ids[i].id] = nil
  end
  invalidateSaveCache()
end

-- Push one finished game record. Keyed by gameId, so re-pushing the same game
-- is idempotent (no double-count).
--
-- IMPORTANT (TTS cross-script ownership): a table passed in from ANOTHER script
-- (e.g. global.lua via obj.call) stays owned by that script and cannot be stored
-- into our own tables. So cross-script callers MUST pass a JSON string; we decode
-- it here into a locally-owned table. Same-script callers may pass a table.
function recordGame(payload)
  local record
  if type(payload) == "string" then
    local ok, decoded = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(payload) end)
    if not ok then return false end
    record = decoded
  elseif type(payload) == "table" then
    record = payload -- only safe for same-script (local) callers
  else
    return false
  end
  if not isValidRecord(record) then return false end
  games[record.gameId] = record
  sessionIds[record.gameId] = true -- recorded live this runtime → counts toward "session" scope
  pruneToCap()
  invalidateSaveCache()
  -- Refresh the face only for LOCAL callers (debug, passing a table). A cross-script
  -- push (JSON string) is the showdown save — DON'T refresh now or the leaderboard
  -- spoils the result before hands are revealed. global.lua refreshes the faces at
  -- cleanup / new-game instead (refreshStatsBookFaces).
  if type(payload) == "table" then updateBookFace() end
  return true
end

-- Return this book's games as a JSON string so another book can union it in.
-- Returning a string (not the live table) avoids the cross-script ownership error.
function exportGames()
  return JSON.encode(games)
end

-- Union another games map into this book. Set-union by gameId → duplicates
-- collapse automatically (same gameId = same game, kept once).
function mergeGames(otherGames)
  if type(otherGames) ~= "table" then return 0 end
  local added = 0
  for gameId, record in pairs(otherGames) do
    if games[gameId] == nil and isValidRecord(record) then
      games[gameId] = record
      added = added + 1
    end
  end
  pruneToCap()
  if added > 0 then invalidateSaveCache() end
  return added
end

-- Scan every stats book on the table (by GMNotes) and union all their games
-- into this one. Skips self. Returns how many new games were absorbed.
-- This is the multi-host merge: 4 hosts spawn 4 books → one combined set.
function mergeAllBooks()
  local added = 0
  for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
    if obj ~= self and obj.getGMNotes() == BOOK_GMNOTES then
      -- exportGames returns a JSON string; decode it here so the resulting
      -- table is owned by THIS script and its sub-tables are safe to store.
      local theirJson = obj.call("exportGames")
      if type(theirJson) == "string" and theirJson ~= "" then
        local ok, theirGames = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(theirJson) end)
        if ok and type(theirGames) == "table" then
          added = added + mergeGames(theirGames)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  updateBookFace()
  return added
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Query helpers (data only — the overlay renders these later)
------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Most-recent display name for a steamId, derived from the newest game record
-- that includes them. The display layer should prefer the LIVE name for
-- currently-seated players (global.lua has it via Player[color].steam_name);
-- this is the fallback for absent players. Returns the steamId itself if no
-- record carries a name. Keying is always by steamId — names are display-only.
function getLastKnownName(steamId)
  local bestTs, bestName = -1, nil
  for _, rec in pairs(games) do
    local p = rec.players and rec.players[steamId]
    if p and p.name and (rec.ts or 0) > bestTs then
      bestTs = rec.ts or 0
      bestName = p.name
    end
  end
  return bestName or steamId
end

-- Weighted accuracy for one player's rounds in ONE game (R4 weighted heaviest).
-- Returns nil if the player has no scored rounds that game.
local function weightedGameAccuracy(rounds)
  local num, wsum = 0, 0
  for r = 1, 4 do
    local t = rounds[r]
    if t and t.score then
      local w = ROUND_WEIGHTS[r] or 1
      num = num + w * t.score
      wsum = wsum + w
    end
  end
  if wsum == 0 then return nil end
  return num / wsum
end

-- Tier label for a rating %. Order-independent: returns the label of the
-- highest floor the rating meets, so TIERS rows can be listed in any order.
local function tierFor(rating)
  local bestFloor, bestLabel = -1, ""
  for _, t in ipairs(TIERS) do
    if rating >= t.floor and t.floor > bestFloor then
      bestFloor = t.floor
      bestLabel = t.label
    end
  end
  return bestLabel
end

-- True if a game is in scope. scope "session" = recorded this runtime; anything
-- else (incl. "career") = all stored games.
local function gameInScope(gameId, scope)
  if scope == "session" then return sessionIds[gameId] == true end
  return true
end

-- Aggregate one player across games in scope.
-- Returns { key, name, rating, tier, gameCount, best, worst, perRound[1..4], history }.
-- history = { { gameId, ts, acc }, ... } ascending by ts (for the sparkline).
function aggregatePlayer(playerKey, scope)
  local res = {
    key = playerKey,
    name = getLastKnownName(playerKey),
    rating = 0,
    tier = "",
    gameCount = 0,
    best = nil,
    worst = nil,
    perRound = {},
    history = {},
  }
  local accSum = 0
  local rSum, rCnt = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }, { 0, 0, 0, 0 }
  for gameId, rec in pairs(games) do
    if gameInScope(gameId, scope) then
      local p = rec.players and rec.players[playerKey]
      if p and p.rounds then
        local acc = weightedGameAccuracy(p.rounds)
        if acc then
          res.gameCount = res.gameCount + 1
          accSum = accSum + acc
          table.insert(res.history, { gameId = gameId, ts = rec.ts or 0, acc = acc })
          if not res.best or acc > res.best then res.best = acc end
          if not res.worst or acc < res.worst then res.worst = acc end
        end
        for r = 1, 4 do
          local t = p.rounds[r]
          if t and t.score then
            rSum[r] = rSum[r] + t.score
            rCnt[r] = rCnt[r] + 1
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  if res.gameCount > 0 then res.rating = accSum / res.gameCount end
  res.tier = tierFor(res.rating)
  for r = 1, 4 do
    if rCnt[r] > 0 then res.perRound[r] = rSum[r] / rCnt[r] end
  end
  table.sort(res.history, function(a, b) return a.ts < b.ts end)
  return res
end

-- Drill-down for one player (career scope). Thin wrapper kept for the overlay.
function queryPlayer(playerKey)
  return aggregatePlayer(playerKey, "career")
end

-- All players ranked by rating, descending. scope = "career" | "session".
function queryLeaderboard(scope)
  local keys = {}
  for gameId, rec in pairs(games) do
    if gameInScope(gameId, scope) then
      for pkey, _ in pairs(rec.players or {}) do keys[pkey] = true end
    end
  end
  local rows = {}
  for pkey, _ in pairs(keys) do
    local agg = aggregatePlayer(pkey, scope)
    if agg.gameCount > 0 then
      agg.ranked = agg.gameCount >= MIN_RANKED_GAMES -- met the games threshold for top ranks
      agg.minRankedGames = MIN_RANKED_GAMES
      table.insert(rows, agg)
    end
  end
  -- Qualified players (>= MIN_RANKED_GAMES) always rank above provisional ones, so a single
  -- perfect game can't top a long near-perfect record. Within each group: accuracy %
  -- (rating) first, ties broken by most games played.
  table.sort(rows, function(a, b)
    if a.ranked ~= b.ranked then return a.ranked end
    if a.rating ~= b.rating then return a.rating > b.rating end
    return (a.gameCount or 0) > (b.gameCount or 0)
  end)
  return rows
end

-- Every player's average accuracy for a single round r, descending.
-- Returns { { key, name, avg, games }, ... }.
function queryRound(r, scope)
  local sum, cnt = {}, {}
  for gameId, rec in pairs(games) do
    if gameInScope(gameId, scope) then
      for pkey, p in pairs(rec.players or {}) do
        local t = p.rounds and p.rounds[r]
        if t and t.score then
          sum[pkey] = (sum[pkey] or 0) + t.score
          cnt[pkey] = (cnt[pkey] or 0) + 1
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local rows = {}
  for pkey, c in pairs(cnt) do
    table.insert(rows, { key = pkey, name = getLastKnownName(pkey), avg = sum[pkey] / c, games = c })
  end
  table.sort(rows, function(a, b) return a.avg > b.avg end)
  return rows
end

-- Session summary: game count + group accuracy (mean of all per-player game
-- accuracies across this runtime's games).
function querySession()
  local num, cnt, gameCount = 0, 0, 0
  for gameId, rec in pairs(games) do
    if sessionIds[gameId] then
      gameCount = gameCount + 1
      for _, p in pairs(rec.players or {}) do
        if p.rounds then
          local acc = weightedGameAccuracy(p.rounds)
          if acc then
            num = num + acc; cnt = cnt + 1
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return { gameCount = gameCount, groupAccuracy = (cnt > 0) and (num / cnt) or 0 }
end

-- JSON wrappers for cross-script use: global.lua reads these and decodes into a
-- locally-owned table to build the overlay (avoids the table-ownership error).
function queryLeaderboardJson(scope) return JSON.encode(queryLeaderboard(scope)) end

function queryPlayerJson(playerKey) return JSON.encode(queryPlayer(playerKey)) end

function querySessionJson() return JSON.encode(querySession()) end

-- Both scopes for one player, so the overlay can show a session-vs-career comparison.
function queryPlayerDetailJson(playerKey)
  return JSON.encode({
    career = aggregatePlayer(playerKey, "career"),
    session = aggregatePlayer(playerKey, "session"),
  })
end

-- queryRound needs two args; .call passes one, so accept a JSON-encoded { r, scope }.
function queryRoundJson(argsJson)
  local ok, a = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(argsJson) end)
  if not ok or type(a) ~= "table" then return JSON.encode({}) end
  return JSON.encode(queryRound(a.r or 4, a.scope or "career"))
end

-- Per-game breakdown of THIS session's games (newest first) for the SESSION tab.
function querySessionGamesJson()
  local list = {}
  for gameId, rec in pairs(games) do
    if sessionIds[gameId] then
      local num, cnt = 0, 0
      for _, p in pairs(rec.players or {}) do
        if p.rounds then
          local acc = weightedGameAccuracy(p.rounds)
          if acc then
            num = num + acc; cnt = cnt + 1
          end
        end
      end
      table.insert(list, {
        gameId = gameId,
        date = rec.date or "?",
        ts = rec.ts or 0,
        groupAccuracy = (cnt > 0) and (num / cnt) or 0,
        playerCount = cnt,
      })
    end
  end
  table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.ts > b.ts end)
  return JSON.encode(list)
end

-- One game's full detail (every player's per-round scores + game accuracy),
-- ranked by accuracy. For the per-game drill-down opened from the SESSION tab.
function queryGameJson(gameId)
  local rec = games[gameId]
  if not rec then return JSON.encode({ players = {} }) end
  local players = {}
  for steamId, p in pairs(rec.players or {}) do
    table.insert(players, {
      key = steamId,
      name = p.name or steamId,
      rounds = p.rounds or {},
      accuracy = (p.rounds and weightedGameAccuracy(p.rounds)) or 0,
    })
  end
  table.sort(players, function(a, b) return a.accuracy > b.accuracy end)
  return JSON.encode({ gameId = gameId, date = rec.date or "?", ts = rec.ts or 0, players = players })
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Book face — at-a-glance leaderboard rendered as object buttons on the book.
-- Shows THIS SESSION's standings for players currently seated at the table
-- (seated set comes from global.lua). Refreshed when the stored games change.
------------------------------------------------------------------------

function doNothing() end

-- Click the header to switch the book face between Session and Career.
function onFaceScopeToggle()
  faceScope = (faceScope == "career") and "session" or "career"
  updateBookFace()
end

-- Re-render the leaderboard onto the book's surface.
function updateBookFace()
  self.clearButtons()

  -- Clickable header that toggles Session ↔ Career (also serves as the title).
  self.createButton({
    click_function = "onFaceScopeToggle",
    function_owner = self,
    label = (faceScope == "career") and "THE GANG SENSE — CAREER" or "THE GANG SENSE — SESSION",
    position = { FACE_TITLE_X, FACE_Y, FACE_COL_Z },
    rotation = FACE_ROTATION,
    width = FACE_TOGGLE_W,
    height = FACE_TOGGLE_H,
    font_size = FACE_TITLE_FONT,
    font_color = FACE_TITLE_COLOR,
    color = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }, -- transparent box; only the text shows
  })

  local rows = queryLeaderboard(faceScope)
  -- In SESSION scope, show only players currently at the table (seated set from
  -- global.lua). CAREER scope shows the all-time board (everyone). If global can't
  -- answer (book spawned standalone), fall back to showing all session players.
  if faceScope == "session" then
    local ok, json = pcall(function() return Global.call("getSeatedSteamIdsJson") end)
    if ok and type(json) == "string" and json ~= "" then
      local okd, list = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(json) end)
      if okd and type(list) == "table" then
        local seated = {}
        for _, id in ipairs(list) do seated[id] = true end
        local filtered = {}
        for _, r in ipairs(rows) do
          if seated[r.key] then table.insert(filtered, r) end
        end
        rows = filtered
      end
    end
  end

  if #rows == 0 then
    self.createButton({
      click_function = "doNothing",
      function_owner = self,
      label = "(no " .. faceScope .. " games)",
      position = { FACE_ROW_X0, FACE_Y, FACE_COL_Z },
      rotation = FACE_ROTATION,
      width = 0,
      height = 0,
      font_size = FACE_ROW_FONT,
      font_color = FACE_DIM_COLOR,
    })
    return
  end

  for i = 1, math.min(FACE_MAX_ROWS, #rows) do
    local r = rows[i]
    self.createButton({
      click_function = "doNothing",
      function_owner = self,
      label = string.format("%d. %s   %.0f%%   %s", i, r.name, r.rating, r.tier),
      position = { FACE_ROW_X0 + (i - 1) * FACE_ROW_DX, FACE_Y, FACE_COL_Z },
      rotation = FACE_ROTATION,
      width = 0,
      height = 0,
      font_size = FACE_ROW_FONT,
      font_color = FACE_ROW_COLOR,
    })
  end
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Debug / test affordances — right-click the book for these. Remove once
-- the overlay ships. All output goes to the TTS console (~ key) and chat.
------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Print to the player who clicked the menu item (not just the host's chat).
local function dprint(pc, msg)
  if pc then printToColor(msg, pc) else print(msg) end
end

-- os.time() before which a 2nd "Clear games" click confirms the wipe (double-gate).
local clearArmedUntil  = 0

-- Browse-and-delete a specific game: a stable cursor over the games (oldest first),
-- advanced by "Browse games to delete", with its own 2nd-click confirm window.
local deleteListing    = {} -- cached, ts-sorted list of gameIds for stable cursor stepping
local deleteCursor     = 0  -- 1-based index into deleteListing (0 = nothing browsed yet)
local deleteArmedUntil = 0  -- os.time() before which a 2nd "Delete browsed game" confirms

-- Host or promoted only — gates the destructive / shared menu actions.
local function isAdmin(pc)
  local p = Player[pc]
  return p ~= nil and (p.host or p.promoted)
end

-- gameId of the most recently recorded game (highest ts), or nil.
local function findLastGameId()
  local lastId, lastTs = nil, -1
  for id, rec in pairs(games) do
    if (rec.ts or 0) > lastTs then
      lastTs = rec.ts or 0
      lastId = id
    end
  end
  return lastId
end

-- All gameIds sorted oldest-first (ts, then id) — a stable order for the delete cursor.
local function sortedGameIds()
  local entries = {}
  for id, rec in pairs(games) do table.insert(entries, { id = id, ts = rec.ts or 0 }) end
  table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
    if a.ts ~= b.ts then return a.ts < b.ts end
    return tostring(a.id) < tostring(b.id)
  end)
  local out = {}
  for _, e in ipairs(entries) do table.insert(out, e.id) end
  return out
end

-- Comma-separated player names for a game record (for the browse/confirm output).
local function gameNames(rec)
  local names = {}
  for _, p in pairs(rec.players or {}) do table.insert(names, p.name or "?") end
  table.sort(names)
  return table.concat(names, ", ")
end

-- Delete the most recently recorded game (its whole record, all scores).
function deleteLastGame(pc)
  local id = findLastGameId()
  if not id then
    dprint(pc, "[StatsBook] no games to delete")
    return
  end
  local date = games[id].date or "?"
  games[id] = nil
  sessionIds[id] = nil
  invalidateSaveCache()
  dprint(pc, "[StatsBook] deleted last game (" .. date .. ")")
  updateBookFace()
end

-- Step the delete cursor to the next game (oldest first) and print its date / players
-- so the admin can identify a specific game (e.g. a fake one) to remove.
function browseGameForDelete(pc)
  deleteListing = sortedGameIds()
  local n = #deleteListing
  if n == 0 then
    deleteCursor = 0
    dprint(pc, "[StatsBook] no games to browse")
    return
  end
  deleteCursor = (deleteCursor % n) + 1
  deleteArmedUntil = 0 -- browsing cancels any armed delete
  local rec = games[deleteListing[deleteCursor]]
  dprint(pc, string.format("[StatsBook] game %d/%d — %s | %s",
    deleteCursor, n, (rec and rec.date) or "?", rec and gameNames(rec) or "?"))
  dprint(pc, "[StatsBook] (Browse again for the next game, or 'Delete browsed game' to remove this one)")
end

-- Delete the currently-browsed game (its whole record). Double-gated: first click arms,
-- a second click within 5s confirms. Browse a game first to set the cursor.
function deleteBrowsedGame(pc)
  local id = deleteListing[deleteCursor]
  if not id or not games[id] then
    dprint(pc, "[StatsBook] Browse a game first (use 'Browse games to delete').")
    deleteListing = {}; deleteCursor = 0; deleteArmedUntil = 0
    return
  end
  local rec = games[id]
  local desc = ((rec and rec.date) or "?") .. " | " .. (rec and gameNames(rec) or "?")
  if os.time() <= deleteArmedUntil then
    games[id] = nil
    sessionIds[id] = nil
    invalidateSaveCache()
    deleteListing = {}; deleteCursor = 0; deleteArmedUntil = 0
    dprint(pc, "[StatsBook] deleted game (" .. desc .. ")")
    updateBookFace()
  else
    deleteArmedUntil = os.time() + 5
    dprint(pc, "[StatsBook] Delete game " .. deleteCursor .. " (" .. desc
      .. ")? Click 'Delete browsed game' again within 5s to confirm.")
  end
end

-- Force every player's Round-4 score in the last game to 100% (for when a
-- challenge made the final round score wrong). Leaves chip/n/srank intact.
function correctLastGameR4(pc)
  local id = findLastGameId()
  if not id then
    dprint(pc, "[StatsBook] no games to correct")
    return
  end
  local fixed = 0
  for _, p in pairs(games[id].players or {}) do
    if p.rounds and p.rounds[4] then
      p.rounds[4].score = 100
      fixed = fixed + 1
    end
  end
  if fixed > 0 then invalidateSaveCache() end
  dprint(pc, "[StatsBook] set R4 to 100% for " .. fixed .. " player(s) in the last game")
  updateBookFace()
end

-- Print the aggregated career leaderboard (rating, games, per-round, tier).
function debugPrintLeaderboard(scope, pc)
  local rows = queryLeaderboard(scope)
  local sess = querySession()
  dprint(pc, "===== [StatsBook] Leaderboard (" .. scope .. ") — top 10 =====")
  for i = 1, math.min(10, #rows) do
    local r = rows[i]
    local pr = {}
    for n = 1, 4 do
      pr[n] = r.perRound[n] and ("R" .. n .. " " .. string.format("%.0f", r.perRound[n])) or ("R" .. n .. " --")
    end
    dprint(pc, string.format("%d. %-12s %3.0f%%  (%d games, best %.0f/worst %.0f)  %s   [%s]",
      i, r.name, r.rating, r.gameCount, r.best or 0, r.worst or 0, r.tier, table.concat(pr, " ")))
  end
  dprint(pc, string.format("Session: %d game(s), group accuracy %.0f%%", sess.gameCount, sess.groupAccuracy))
end

-- Print every player's average accuracy for each round (who reads which street best).
function debugPrintRounds(scope, pc)
  for r = 1, 4 do
    local rows = queryRound(r, scope)
    local parts = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
      table.insert(parts, string.format("%s %.0f%%", row.name, row.avg))
    end
    dprint(pc, "R" .. r .. ": " .. table.concat(parts, "  |  "))
  end
end

-- Print a readable summary of every stored game to the console / chat.
function debugPrintGames(pc)
  local count = 0
  for _ in pairs(games) do count = count + 1 end
  dprint(pc, "===== [StatsBook] " .. count .. " game(s) stored =====")
  for gameId, rec in pairs(games) do
    dprint(pc, "- " .. (rec.date or "?") .. "  [" .. gameId .. "]")
    for pkey, p in pairs(rec.players or {}) do
      local parts = {}
      for r = 1, 4 do
        local t = p.rounds and p.rounds[r]
        if t then
          table.insert(parts, "R" .. r .. " " .. string.format("%.0f", t.score) .. "%")
        end
      end
      dprint(pc, "    " .. (p.name or pkey) .. ": " .. table.concat(parts, "  "))
    end
  end
end

-- Fixed test "personalities": stable steamId per player (so stats accumulate
-- across injected games) and a per-player accuracy range to simulate skill.
local DEBUG_PERSONAS = {
  { steamId = "test_blue",   name = "Blue",   lo = 80, hi = 100 }, -- strong, consistent
  { steamId = "test_green",  name = "Green",  lo = 70, hi = 95 },  -- good
  { steamId = "test_red",    name = "Red",    lo = 10, hi = 90 },  -- wild swings
  { steamId = "test_yellow", name = "Yellow", lo = 30, hi = 60 },  -- weak
}

-- Inject one synthetic 4-player game with all 4 rounds randomized per personality,
-- so the aggregation can be exercised realistically with no global.lua.
function debugInjectFakeGame(pc)
  local n = #DEBUG_PERSONAS
  local players = {}
  for _, persona in ipairs(DEBUG_PERSONAS) do
    local rounds = {}
    for r = 1, 4 do
      rounds[r] = { score = math.random(persona.lo, persona.hi), chip = math.random(0, n - 1), n = n }
    end
    players[persona.steamId] = { name = persona.name, rounds = rounds }
  end
  recordGame({
    gameId  = tostring(os.time()) .. "-test-" .. tostring(math.random(100000, 999999)),
    ts      = os.time(),
    date    = os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
    players = players,
  })
  local count = 0
  for _ in pairs(games) do count = count + 1 end
  dprint(pc, "[StatsBook] injected 4-player game; games stored: " .. count)
end
